raw_segments.text: He walked back along Dorset Street, reading gravely.
A Gendath net aim, Planter's company, to purchase waste-sandy tracks from Turkish government
Excellent for shade, fuel and construction.
Orange agroves and immense melon fields north of Jaffa.
You pay 80 marks and they plant a duneum of land for you with olives, oranges, almonds
Every year you get a sending of the crop.
Your name entered for life as owner in the Book of the Union.
Can pay 10 down and the balance in yearly installments.
